overview.title: Desk overview (morning brief, macro, energy)
overview.read: The morning brief on Wed Oct 21, 2026 shows Class III milk down 0.59 cents (-3.3%) and KC HRW wheat down 17.25 cents (-2.5%) as the biggest moves versus prior settlement. The desk’s strongest views remain strongly bearish on corn and KC HRW wheat. Macro backdrop for ags is a -2 headwind score, with a neutral rate outlook, a weaker dollar, negative Mexico peso pressure, positive energy, and negative China sentiment. Energy data shows gas storage at 3,567 Bcf (week to 2026-10-09) and crude stocks at 412.5 mb, influencing farm fuel and ethanol margins. A flash export sale of 114,000 MT of soybeans to China and 261,000 MT to unknown destinations was reported in the last three days.

faq.q: What matters most today?
faq.a: The top priority today is the USDA NDPSR dairy product price release at 12:00 PM ET, which will set weekly dairy pricing. Additionally, the recent flash export sale of 114,000 MT of soybeans to China and 261,000 MT to unknown destinations (reported in the last three days) could influence soybean market sentiment. Traders should also watch the continued weakness in KC HRW wheat, which fell 17.25 cents (-2.5%) in the prior session.

faq.q: What is the macro backdrop for ags?
faq.a: The macro backdrop for ags is a -2 headwind score, reflecting pressure across several factors. Rates are neutral (0), the dollar is weakening (−), Brazil’s real is neutral (0), the Mexican peso is negative (−), risk is neutral (0), energy is positive (+), China sentiment is negative (−), and market breadth is neutral (0). High real yields and a firm dollar are limiting fund demand, while sticky inflation keeps rates elevated, raising carry and storage costs for commodities.

ZC.title: Corn
ZC.read: The desk is strongly bearish on Corn with high conviction, driven by a convergence of bearish fundamentals, technicals, and fund flows. Fundamentals are pressured by 2026/27 ending stocks rising to 1,849 million bushels and export commitments running 25% below normal pace. Technically, the Dec 26 contract is oversold with an RSI of 27, trading at 464.25 ¢/bu, which is down 13.5% on the month. Managed money is net long 230,877 lots but is actively liquidating, with a weekly drop of 86,482 lots indicating a shift toward short positioning.

faq.a: The desk view is strongly bearish with high conviction because all three analytical lenses—fundamentals, technicals, and flows—point in the same direction. Fundamentals are bearish due to rising ending stocks and weak export demand, while technicals show a sell rating with the price near support. Flows are strongly bearish as managed money is liquidating longs, and the trend score is -1.00, indicating all signals are short.
